acceptanceCriteria: After a batch merges, a single command lists its delivered tickets and closes each with the merged PR's CI evidence, or reports why it cannot
The open-and-referenced count is reported by a query and reaches 0 for tickets whose delivery is verified
Tickets that were only mentioned, not delivered, stay OPEN
body: On 2026-10-21, 84 OPEN tickets with milestone v1-0 are referenced in origin/main commit messages or merged batch PR bodies. Each must be verified and closed by hand with complete-manual citing the merged PR's green CI run, which lags merges by hours and makes those tickets look undone to dispatch (feeds the duplicate-dispatch problem). #1436 (V1-2216, CI-evidence gate) would let completion cite the cloud run without a local gate.

title: Closeout lag: 84 OPEN v1-0 tickets are referenced by commits on origin/main
